guard: after the endpoint says this session's stored copies reached their limit (#5404), the next cotal_inbox reply carries one notice in either attention mode, a peek keeps it, and the read that carries it clears it
why: S1 drops the agent's listener, so the event marks nothing.
S2 never clears the notice, so every read repeats it.
S3 clears it on a peek, so the read after the peek loses it.
S4 and S5 drop it from the reply outside and inside focus mode.
NO BUILD STEP: the suite imports ../src.

mutations.name: S1 the agent ignores the endpoint's event
mutations.expectRed: the endpoint's stored-copies-full event marks the session

mutations.name: S2 the notice is never cleared
mutations.expectRed: the read after it does not repeat it

mutations.name: S3 a peek clears the notice
mutations.expectRed: a peek carries the notice once and keeps it

mutations.name: S4 the reply outside focus mode drops the notice
mutations.expectRed: a peek carries the notice once and keeps it

mutations.name: S5 the empty focus reply drops the notice
mutations.expectRed: in focus mode the next read carries the notice once
